verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observability docs say the Browserbase session dashboard offers real-time browser screen recording and replay, which covers watching a run live. Browserbase is one of Stagehand's documented first-class browser options, but the live view is Browserbase-hosted, so the credit is limited. Nothing in the pack shows a human can take control of the browser mid-run when the agent gets stuck. Missing for 10: documented human takeover or intervention during a running session, a live view outside the Browserbase dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration of live viewing.
